title: Free-vector-space-valued recursion and induction on a well-founded relation
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $B,W$ be sets, and put $V=k^{(B)}$, the vector space of finitely supported functions $B\to k$. Let $r\subseteq W\times W$ be well founded, meaning that every nonempty subset $A\subseteq W$ contains $a\in A$ with no $b\in A$ satisfying $r(b,a)$. For every $x\in W$ let $H_x:(\prod_{y\in W,\ r(y,x)}V)\to V$ be a function. There exists $g:W\to V$ satisfying $g(x)=H_x((g(y))_{r(y,x)})$ for every $x\in W$. Moreover, for any predicate $P$ on $W$, if $(\forall y,\ r(y,x)\Rightarrow P(y))\Rightarrow P(x)$ holds for every $x\in W$, then $P(x)$ holds for every $x\in W$. No totality or transitivity of $r$ is assumed; $B$ and $W$ may be empty.
